data.narrative:
SirenOpt is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jared O'Leary, Ali Mesbah, and Joel Paulson that has raised $19.0M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of nine private robotics peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public comparable (277810.KQ), though peer-median benchmarking proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage datapoints within the narrow peer set.

The primary valuation method employed is stage-progression analysis. Using the $19.0M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $48M. This single applicable method constrains the triangulation range to $40M–$55M (representing a ±15% confidence band around the $48M median). The narrow methodological foundation reflects data limitations rather than fundamental company quality.

The analysis supports a median valuation of $48M with a defensible range of $40M to $55M. Key uncertainties include the lack of direct peer-stage comparables and the absence of recent financing rounds to validate stage-progression multiples specific to this sector cohort. Further clarity would require either expanded peer diligence or disclosure of recent term sheets.
